question: How long does my password need to be?
queries: How long does my password need to be?

results.title: IT Security Policy
results.heading: Passwords
results.text: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must not be reused across systems.

results.title: Travel Policy
results.heading: Cabin class
results.text: Economy class is the standard for all flights. Directors and above may book business class for flights longer than 6 hours.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Annual paid leave
results.text: Full-time employees earn 20 days of paid leave per calendar year, accrued at 1.67 days per month.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Part-time employees
results.text: Part-time employees earn paid leave in proportion to their contracted hours. An employee contracted for 20 hours a week earns 10 days per year.

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Office days
results.text: Employees assigned to the headquarters office must work on site at least 2 days per week. Each team chooses its office days.
